data.description:
## Incident Overview
When running merge-to-main.sh with merge.strategy=pr, if any required CI check fails (e.g., Script Tests), the script continues waiting for the PR to auto-merge indefinitely. This was observed during the 2026-05-05 sprint session for epic c6de-76e7-5e4b-4968.

## Observed Behavior
- merge-to-main.sh creates PR #49 and queues auto-merge
- Script Tests CI check fails
- merge-to-main.sh does not detect the failure and return — it blocks waiting for merge
- User must manually interrupt the session

## Expected Behavior
- merge-to-main.sh should poll CI check status
- On any required check failure, it should: (a) surface the failing check names, (b) optionally enter the remediation phase, and (c) return with a clear error rather than hanging

## Workaround
Manually interrupt merge-to-main.sh and fix the failing checks, then re-run.

## Root Cause (suspected)
The auto-merge wait loop does not check whether any required check has entered a terminal FAILED state. It only polls for merge completion.
data.title: [merge-to-main-pr.sh]: PR checks fail -> merge-to-main.sh hangs indefinitely waiting for auto-merge
